@allure.title("Complete Autoliv Dashboard Sign-Out Test")
    @allure.severity(allure.severity_level.CRITICAL)
    def test_complete_sign_out_workflow():
        # Configure Chrome with enhanced options
        options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
        options.add_argument("--start-maximized")
        options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
        options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
        options.add_experimental_option("excludeSwitches", ["enable-automation"])
    
        # Enable browser logging for debugging
        options.set_capability("goog:loggingPrefs", {"browser": "ALL"})
    
        driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)
    
        try:
            # 1. Login Process
            with allure.step("1. Login to Dashboard"):
                driver.get("https://alv-vicas.livnsense.com/#/auth/login")
    
                # Wait for and fill username
                username_field = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Username']"))
                )
                username_field.clear()
                username_field.send_keys("madan")
    
                # Fill password
                password_field = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Password']")
                password_field.clear()
                password_field.send_keys("Madan@123")
    
                # Click sign in
                sign_in_button = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//button[contains(text(), 'Sign In')]")
                sign_in_button.click()
    
                # Verify successful login
                WebDriverWait(driver, 30).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//img[@alt='Autoliv']"))
                )
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="1_login_success",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            # 2. Verify Username
            with allure.step("2. Verify Username Display"):
                username = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.profile-img div.user-name"))
                )
                assert username.text.strip() == "Madan", f"Expected 'Madan' but found '{username.text}'"
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="2_username_verified",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            # 3. Sign Out Process
            with allure.step("3. Execute Sign Out"):
                # Click profile dropdown with retry logic
                dropdown_found = False
                for attempt in range(3):
                    try:
                        dropdown_icon = WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                            EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.profile-img div.dropdown-icon"))
                        )
                        # Scroll into view and click with JavaScript
                        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView(true);", dropdown_icon)
                        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", dropdown_icon)
                        time.sleep(1)  # Wait for animation
                        dropdown_found = True
                        break
                    except Exception as e:
                        if attempt == 2:
                            allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                                          name="3_dropdown_failure",
                                          attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
                            raise Exception("Failed to click profile dropdown after 3 attempts") from e
                        continue
    
                # Wait for sign-out dialog with multiple verification methods
                dialog_visible = False
                try:
                    # Method 1: Wait for specific dialog text
                    WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                        EC.text_to_be_present_in_element(
                            (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box .main.txt"),
                            "Are you sure you want to sign out?"
                        )
                    )
                    dialog_visible = True
                except:
                    try:
                        # Method 2: Wait for dialog container
                        WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box"))
                        )
                        dialog_visible = True
                    except:
                        allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                                      name="4_dialog_not_found",
                                      attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
                        raise Exception("Sign out dialog not found after dropdown click")
    
                if dialog_visible:
                    allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                                  name="5_dialog_visible",
                                  attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
                    # Find and click sign-out button with multiple selector attempts
                    sign_out_success = False
                    sign_out_selectors = [
                        (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.sign-out-btn"),  # Primary selector
                        (By.XPATH, "//button[contains(., 'Sign Out')]"),  # Text-based fallback
                        (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box button:last-child"),  # Dialog button fallback
                        (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.btn-danger")  # Danger button fallback
                    ]
    
                    for selector in sign_out_selectors:
                        try:
                            sign_out_button = WebDriverWait(driver, 5).until(
                                EC.element_to_be_clickable(selector)
                            )
                            # Click with JavaScript and verify action
                            driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", sign_out_button)
    
                            # Verify sign out by checking URL change
                            WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                                EC.url_contains("auth/login")
                            )
                            sign_out_success = True
                            break
                        except Exception:
                            continue
    
                    if not sign_out_success:
                        raise AssertionError("All attempts to sign out failed - button not found or click didn't work")
    
                    allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                                  name="6_signout_success",
                                  attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
        except Exception as e:
            # Capture detailed failure information
            allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                          name="7_failure_state",
                          attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
            # Capture browser console logs
            logs = driver.get_log("browser")
            allure.attach(str(logs),
                          name="browser_console_logs",
                          attachment_type=AttachmentType.TEXT)
